WIC27A-01.note: Bypassed town with same families and no new building since 1951 is preserved unchanged; drained tempts from the trucks leaving but the mill kept its orders.

WIC27A-02.note: Papers lost ad money and shrank to local coverage and one bulletin: crippled. Dethroned fails because radio had no reporters and depended on papers; fractured fails on their joint vote.

WIC27A-03.note: Coal heaped and taken on by steamers every voyage while sailing ships passed: a coaling depot. Haven/gateway fit the strait setting but not the coal logic.

WIC27A-04.note: Founders met there, files kept, couriers dispatched: headquarters. Hub is a near-miss covering only the courier/letter traffic.

WIC27A-05.note: Adult salmon rest in the pool then spawn miles upstream: a resting stop on the journey. Hatchery fails (spawning is elsewhere), garden fails (seedlings die), highway tempts from the log's orientation.

WIC27A-06.note: Barred new members, the union died out as veterans retired: doomed. Disbanded is too direct; defanged fails since employers kept paying scale.

WIC27A-07.note: Same length, every line reworked for rising tricks, rhyme and a last-line surprise: sharpened. Distilled fails on unchanged length; domesticated fails because the desert setting (wells) is kept.

WIC27A-08.note: One family owns it and tenants harvest dates to its warehouses: a private estate. Emporium/gatehouse tempt from the caravan road but there is no trade or toll.

WIC27B-01.note: Stoats cross the whole hedge in one night and vole count is unchanged: a travel corridor. Inn fails on same-night transit, larder on the vole count.

WIC27B-02.note: Sand filled hollows so whole farms plowed straight; wheat no thicker rules out nourished. Leveled.

WIC27B-03.note: Walled ledge of ochre-dusted burials, living sites by the river: mortuary. The burial sentence alone nearly decides it; lodge is the only real competitor.

WIC27B-04.note: Load-by-load payments from a naval shipyard then stump-pulling and grass on a kept estate: he felled and sold the oak. Liquidated fails since he kept the estate and hands.

WIC27B-05.note: Stunted growth and speed with fertility, lifespan, behaviour and disease risk unchanged: the worm drains resources without other effects. Manipulated (classic parasite reading), neutered and immunized are each ruled out by a separate sentence.

WIC27B-06.note: Uniform yearly layers whatever the weather, used by others to count years: a steady timekeeper. Ledger is a near-miss (a record), but its layers record nothing except years.

WIC27B-07.note: Interchangeable parts down to the springs, engineers worked from bought machines: copied. Leapfrogged tempts from outselling but the evidence is about copying, not surpassing.

WIC27B-08.note: Twelve owners' marks and a twelve-man crew sharing a shed: a pooled common fund. Insurance/inventory are plausible; loot weak.

WIC27C-01.note: Sowing outside strains beside local wheat and publishing results: a testing ground. Yardstick tempts from the comparison; wellspring from the closed seed merchant though it sold no seed.

WIC27C-02.note: Merchants and boats moved to the village quay while catches reached the same shops: the market relocated. Stifled is the near-miss.

WIC27C-03.note: Bare rock grooved downhill and debris offshore; tide mark and stream unchanged rule out submerged and tilted. Smothered fails on bare rock.

WIC27C-04.note: Water seeps out through the floor, river half as wide below, bed bare in dry summers: a sink. Thermostat tempts from the 70-degree ponds and shallow lake; valve from flow control.

WIC27C-05.note: Paint faced with tissue, oak shaved away, now on canvas: transferred to a new support. Scrubbed/uncovered fail on unchanged smoke-browned saints.

WIC27C-06.note: Giant flings icy bodies on long paths out of the system: slingshot. Umbrella fails because a quarter go inward across the rocky orbits; shepherd fails as it depletes rather than confines.

WIC27C-07.note: Three-minute sides meant ballads were learned by their first five or six verses: cut down. Smoothed fails (voices taken as found), transplanted fails (sold in local stores). 'Stripped' is slightly imprecise for truncation.

WIC27C-08.note: Plant stored whole imported cars and staff only washed, checked and loaded them: a warehouse. Toehold fails because the company had sold there since 1930.

WIC27D-01.note: Dry crest from shore to island at low tide and sheep pastured on the island: a causeway. Barricade/chokepoint fail since the fleet sails over it anywhere.

WIC27D-02.note: Sand stripped to cobbles, shape and hook unchanged, less erosion afterwards: armored. Others are each ruled out by the unchanged-use sentence.

WIC27D-03.note: Spring water piped to fountains because wells are brackish: aqueduct. Border tempts (runs through the middle) and artery is a loose near-miss.

WIC27D-04.note: Buys at harvest, sells at best price even in famine (not a backstop), no hearth tax except when the river closed: a revenue source. Cudgel baits on the toll quarrels.

WIC27D-05.note: Galleries lit and stocked, square emptied at the sirens: shelter. Arena and bazaar are weak; cesspool contradicted by clear water.

WIC27D-06.note: Shallows from both banks, harvest carts reach the far town by way of it: a crossing. Citadel/ark fail on the burned barns and flood line.

WIC27D-07.note: Dead-end passages and an upright flame rule out chimney/bellows; a drip basin the village draws on: cistern. Cooler tempts from the cave temperature.

WIC27D-08.note: Brushwork faint, rims opaque, white whiter, surface smooth and non-staining: the glaze turned opaque. Blackened, blistered, cracked each contradicted by a clause.

WIC27E-01.note: Clear water sank through salt-crusted sandy ground into ditches; yield recovered but grazing no better: salt washed out. Replenished is the near-miss ruled out by the grazing sentence.

WIC27E-02.note: Same festival week, taller gate, city tolls halved: a competitor. Offshoot fails since monks came from a different order.

WIC27E-03.note: Dark water grows nothing (not pantry); young cod hide beneath it from sight-hunting birds: a protective roof.

WIC27E-04.note: Flow held (mill at usual speed) but trout died in shallow treeless reaches and lived near cold springs: overheated. Pinched/parched fail on the flow.

WIC27E-05.note: Empty houses filled, families stayed, school reopened: repopulated. Reoriented is the only near-miss; ruined/overran are surface-strikable.

WIC27E-06.note: Scattered surface craters worked in daylight, forest and bulk intact: pitted. Riddled is the near-miss but implies holes throughout/tunnels; razed and poisoned contradicted.

WIC27E-07.note: Raised and cut by alternating parties, ending near its start: pendulum. Ratchet is the opposite (one-way); regulator weak given swings.

WIC27E-08.note: Sealed doors, banned books still shelved, rare-book seal dated 1940: shut up, not purged or plundered. Padlocked is a little literal but fits.
